targetText: Marriage constitutes one phase of the sex relations of bourgeois society; prostitution constitutes the other.
summary: Bebel demonstrates that prostitution is not an isolated moral failing, but a necessary social institution of bourgeois society, forming the shadowy complement to pecuniary bourgeois marriage and driven directly by female poverty, low wages, and patriarchal double standards.
